prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
Reordering sign-in steps consistently hurt performance across tests.
Finish layout changes consistently hurt performance across tests.
Adoption copy, home redesign, home wait-info, sign-in hints, and sign-in redesign showed no clear effect across tests.
Choose path redesign produced the first winning test (choose_path_card_redesign), though results for that kind of change remain mixed.
Predictions were generally too high across most tests, though pessimistic negative predictions were sometimes inaccurate (e.g., predicting -7.0% for the winning choose_path_card_redesign).
Evidence remains thin for adoption hint, adoption new_flow, adoption new_screen, adoption redesign, choose_path hint, choose_path layout, finish incentive, finish notification, home new_flow, and home new_screen, as each has only 1 test so far.

Changes:
0: [adoption, new_screen] adoption_photo_preview_confirmation_screen: Add a new confirmation step right after uploading photos so users can inspect and approve photo quality before starting pet generation. (why: 3 support complaints noted custom pet generation failing or looking wrong, and adoption conversion drops to 60.9%.)
1: [finish, new_flow] finish_desktop_launch_new_flow: Introduce a guided launch walkthrough on the final screen showing where the pet lands on the desktop and how to summon it. (why: Support receives messages about pets not showing on desktop, and finish stage conversion drops to 64.8%.)
2: [choose_path, new_screen] choose_path_preview_new_screen: Insert a short teaser preview screen before choosing a path to demonstrate desktop pet behaviors live. (why: 23.4% of users drop off at choose_path in median 8 seconds; showcasing app capabilities early boosts intent.)
3: [adoption, hint] upload_photo_quality_tip_hint: Add an explicit photo quality tip on the photo upload screen explaining lighting and pose requirements. (why: Adoption fails frequently and support receives complaints about custom pet generation looking wrong.)
4: [home, wait_info] waiting_estimated_time_progress_info: Show dynamic estimated remaining time and rotating tips during the generation waiting phase. (why: Home waiting step takes a median of 201s (mean 2336s), causing drop-offs while users wait blindly.)
5: [finish, notification] home_intro_desktop_ready_notification: Enable desktop notification prompt on the finish screen so users know when the pet is active. (why: 3 support tickets noted pets not showing or users not realizing the app opened successfully after setup.)
6: [choose_path, hint] story_welcome_quick_overview_hint: Add a reassuring setup duration hint to the story welcome screen. (why: Choose path drops over 23% of users; setting expectation of a fast 2-minute setup lowers friction.)
